description: Source code implementing a test Git filter protocol version 2, including command processing, capability negotiation, and special test case handling for rot13 encoding.

methods.name: rot13
methods.description: Performs rot13 encoding/decoding on a string.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Extracts the value for a given key from a key=value buffer.

methods.name: packet_key_val_read
methods.description: Reads a packet line expecting a key=value format for a specific key.

methods.name: assert_remote_capability
methods.description: Checks if a capability is present in the remote capabilities set.

methods.name: read_capabilities
methods.description: Reads capabilities from the peer and asserts required capabilities.

methods.name: check_and_write_capabilities
methods.description: Verifies local capabilities against remote and sends supported capabilities.

methods.name: free_delay_entries
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for delay entries.

methods.name: add_delay_entry
methods.description: Adds a delay entry for a specific pathname.

methods.name: reply_list_available_blobs_cmd
methods.description: Handles the list_available_blobs command, responding with delayed or available blobs.

methods.name: command_loop
methods.description: Main loop processing commands from the peer.

methods.name: packet_initialize
methods.description: Performs initial handshake and version negotiation.

methods.name: cmd__rot13_filter
methods.description: Main entry point for the rot13-filter command, setting up capabilities and running the protocol.
